translations.title: Multivitamin-Mineral Tablet — Vitamins D, E, B and C + Zinc (no vitamin A, no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins D, E, B1, B2, B6 and C during physical fatigue, low energy, the growth period and old age; to help prevent rickets; for neuralgia, muscle pain and joint pain; for angular cheilitis and mouth sores; to relieve beriberi and eye fatigue; and to supply zinc.
translations.usage: Children aged 12 or older and adults take one tablet once a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive, or if you have high blood calcium, sarcoidosis, kidney disease, kidney stones, severe kidney failure or soy hypersensitivity, or if the child is under 12 months old. If you have diabetes, gout or abnormal fat metabolism, consult a pharmacist. This combination does not contain vitamin A or iron.

translations.title: Multivitamin Tablet — Vitamins B, C, D and E + Zinc (no vitamin A, no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6, C, D and E during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, low energy during and after illness, the growth period and old age and to help prevent rickets; for neuralgia, muscle pain and joint pain; for angular cheilitis and mouth sores; to relieve beriberi and eye fatigue; and to supply zinc.
translations.usage: Children aged 8 or older and adults take one tablet once a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive, or if you have high blood calcium, sarcoidosis, kidney disease, kidney stones or soy hypersensitivity, or if the child is under 12 months old. If you have gout, are prone to blood clots or are low in folate, consult a pharmacist. Because this combination does not contain vitamin A or iron, the warnings about 5,000 IU of vitamin A in pregnancy and iron poisoning do not apply.
